_comment: Blocks declared before this gate reached `main` (bean `zldg`, PR #951). The gate was written against a store that did not yet contain these, and both are GENUINE blocks on the owner — that is what they say — recorded without the four fields because the fields did not exist to record. Listed, never failed; anything outside fails. An entry nothing matches is reported STALE and does fail, so the file can only shrink.
_why_not_repaired_here: Two of the three fields each of these omits are JUDGEMENTS that belong to the bean's owner, not to whoever ran the check. `expires` is a date somebody has to choose, and `handoff` says what happens when it passes — take the decision over, or re-raise it and move the date. `10uc` and `w0cr` are the stream 2 and stream 3 consolidation claims (issue #956); their author supplies those two fields. Filling them in from outside would be inventing a schedule for somebody else's block, which is the same error `bean-blocking.md` names for an external block: `cz17` waits on WHO and no agent may invent WHO's date.
_shape: Same as bean-parents-baseline.json. Key is `<rule>:<bean-id>` — stable across a title edit, because a title is prose and an id is not.
